Name: DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface for Ferngill Simple Economy UI
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[center]Replaces the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21414]Ferngill Simple Economy[/url]﻿ stock icon in the game menu to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url]﻿.
Also contains a slightly edited version that matches [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21436]Taiyoo's Vanilla Tweaks - Interface Edition[/url]﻿ [i](Earthy version)[/i].[/center][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[size=3][center][color=#f1c232][b]1.[/b] [/color]Install SMAPI 4.2.1
[color=#f1c232][b]2.[/b][/color] Download this mod and extract it.
[color=#f1c232][b]3.[/b][/color] Drop the extracted folder into your Mods Folder.[/center][/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/pOatute.png[/img]
[center][size=3]﻿- [/size][size=3][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/VogonTyrant]VogonTyrant[/url] for creating Ferngill Simple Economy.
[/size][size=3]- [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] for their excellent recolor mods (I always use those in my playthroughs).
- Continually thankful for [/size][size=3][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou]Tai[/url]'s VT mods <3[/size][/center]
